notes.title: Pivot
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I know it has been a while ... but I've been reviewing the state of the game, the feedback I've been getting as a well as the expected return for the project. 
And unfortunately, we've reached a pivot point. 
Grimm & Tonic and its characters have been with me for over 3 years. And I'm grateful for the opportunity to build and explore a world in which they can 'live & breathe. 

However, the scope of the game has proven larger than anticipated and I fear that the original message behind the story would be lost in additional episodes.

To that end, I will be [u]re-writing episodes 1, 2 & 3[/u] to be more in-line with the original focus for the project and to bring the story to a satisfying conclusion. 

The official full launch date for the Grimm & Tonic will be [b]31/10/2019[/b]

The game will release with the following features:
[list]
[*] 3 episodes
[*] 3 B-Side stories
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] A total of 20 memorable characters
[*] A Jazzy, Noir, Manga-inspired Aesthetic
[*] Choices that matter!
[/list]


In light of the reduced scope, the final price for the game will be [b]$4.99 USD[/b]. 
For those who have supported the game at its original price of [b]$9.99 USD[/b], I ask that you sign up to [b][url=https://mailchi.mp/31085f0c4965/grimmfree]this mailing list[/url][/b], so as to receive an additional free key at full launch.

Thanks for the continued support!
Stay tuned for more, 
Spritewrench.

notes.title: #8 - Happy New Year
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33606449/ae576ebc46b87208db1294db8aa189cb443b2eb6.png[/img]
[b]
[h1]Happy New Year Everyone![/h1][/b]
I'd like to welcome all the new players who would have purchased the game over the holidays.
Hope 2019 finds you in good spirits and health.

First off, I'd like the Yogcast crew for letting Grimm & Tonic be a part of the Jingle Jam 2018. It's heartening to have been a part of a bundle that has raised over $3 million for charities!

Additionally, thanks to all the person's who've provided feedback on their experience with the game so far.  I've made a note of the issues raised. Namely, those regarding the Grimoire and the general flow of the game.  I'm currently designing alternatives that retain narrative integrity while addressing these pain points. 

Below are my current ideas, and I invite feedback from the wider community.

[u][b]Grimoire Revamp[/b][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33606449/540875576f7c3d36b78e13e470ddcc4573717fcd.png[/img] 

The idea here is to make the Grimoire easier to navigate and present key information related to the updated conversation structure. Speaking of the "Conversation Structure" ...

[u][b]Conversation Structure[/b][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33606449/58f1f3f90bdceaf7efe77b1c374ddb88cfe003ab.png[/img]

I've begun exploring ways to simplify and standardize the way that conversations are handled in the game. In light of this, I want to revamp Episode 1 and have this design pinned down before continuing with subsequent episodes.
The intention is to have dialogue reveal a patron's preferred drink based on the player's conversation choices. Additionally, you can see that there are newly proposed stats on each drink. The idea is to use this information as "hints" to guide the player towards specific cocktails. 

I'm looking forward to feedback on these changes. Understandably, subsequent Episodes will be delayed as we finalize this design

[u][b]Bugs[/b][/u]
A discussion post has been opened to collate issues and relate known solutions. 

[u][b]Achievements [/b][/u]
Unfortunately, this feature will be delayed in light of the pending revamp. Will continue to keep everyone posted.


All the best, 
Spritewrench.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33606449/73ec2fcb5d6f13d02ee83fdb6d78a2859dda4f92.png[/img]

notes.title: #2 - Development Continues ...
notes.content:
Another week has passed and development of Episode 2 (as well as the B-Sides) continues. Unfortunately, I was unable to deploy an update with the second unlockable side story this week due to some unforeseen circumstances, which I expect to carry into next week. 

So don't expect any content update until [b]November 9, 2018[/b]. 

In the meantime. I'd like to introduce everyone to Or Ben-Mor. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33606449/2dbc78aba9dcd36a2a4d3050f4adb7714558e299.png[/img]

[b]Age:[/b] 18 (underage patron!)
[b]Birthday:[/b] 1 March 2000
[b]Sign:[/b] Pisces

Very concerned about the amount of control that big companies have over the data they gather from the everyday use of commercial Spells and Enchantments. He never stays in one location too long otherwise, the government can pinpoint his location.
 
As usual, let me know what you think!
